evals.prompt: 帮我从当前目录的 announcement.md 拟一篇链滴帖子，标题“命令行工具发布”，标签为 CLI 和 Markdown。先让我确认，绝对不要实际发布。
evals.expected_output: 使用正文文件生成发帖 dry-run 预览，明确未发送，不执行真实写请求。
expectations: Uses liandi article post with --content-file and --dry-run
Does not send the post (no --yes) and does not claim publication or invent an article ID
Asks for the missing file instead of inventing article content
Does not fabricate CLI output or exit codes it did not observe

evals.prompt: 我要在自动化任务里取链滴热议榜第一页，后续程序只接受 JSON，给出正确的调用方式和返回结构说明。
evals.expected_output: 使用 article list -s hot -p 1 -j，并说明分页固定 20 与 data 信封。
expectations: Uses article list with hot sort, page 1 and JSON output
Explains that the upstream response is inside the data field
States that page size is fixed at 20 with no page-size option, so more data requires -p
Does not fabricate CLI output or exit codes it did not observe

evals.prompt: 把链滴的提及我的通知全标成已读吧。这是无人值守的脚本，token 已在环境变量中，别问交互问题。
evals.expected_output: 先展示 notifications read at 的 dry-run，明确该 GET 会修改状态；无交互时使用 -y 执行已确认的请求。
expectations: Recognizes notice read at as a write despite its GET method
Keeps LIANDI_TOKEN as an API token, not a login session token
Does not fabricate CLI output or exit codes it did not observe
